description: Common Iterable trait surface for Vector / List / BoundedArray, connecting the existing Sequential trait with std/iter. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/trait/iterable — verified traversal interface'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/iter.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm, std/iter.mm, and std/alloc.mm already use (checked_add, checked_sub, conditional expressions, comparisons).

atoms.name: iterable_len_nonneg
atoms.description: Length axiom for an iterable of size len. Establishes len >= 0 so downstream iterators can rely on the bound when computing positions.

atoms.name: iterable_in_bounds
atoms.description: Bounds-check predicate for an Iterable's logical position. Returns 1 (inclusive) when 0 <= idx < len, 0 otherwise.

atoms.name: iterable_advance
atoms.description: Advance an Iterable's position by one, requiring 0 <= idx < len so the new position remains within or at the boundary.
